collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — INNER LIFE, PART V (81-100, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager tidying their hut finds a list written as a teenager of things to do when grown up.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Tidying (subject.his/her) hut, (subject) finds a scrap of old bark with writing on it, in the wobbly hand of a teenager. It's a list: THINGS I WILL DO WHEN I'M GROWN UP. Number one: be the best fisher on Isola. Number two: never eat beans again. Number three: have a pet seabird called Captain. (subject) sits down on the floor to read the rest.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (subject) reads the whole list slowly. Some of it makes (subject.him/her) laugh. Some of it makes (subject.him/her) a little wistful. Some of it (subject.he/she) doesn't remember wanting at all. (subject.He/She) doesn't feel like a failure or a success, just like someone who used to be fifteen. (subject.He/She) tucks the list away again. The seabird, (subject.he/she) thinks, is still technically possible.

a__fx.name: Answer A
a__fx.text: (friend) reads the list and laughs until (friend.he/she) cries. "Did you do any of these?" (subject) thinks. "I'm a decent fisher. I eat beans all the time. No Captain." "So one out of three?" "Half out of three." They agree that's a perfectly respectable score for a whole life so far.
